Class Wizard

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.wizard.Wizard
@ViewScoped public final class Wizard extends Object
Shows the content of a dialog view as a sequence of steps, with Previous and Next, each step validated before the next: the view injects it, returns what steps returns from its content(), or places it, and returns what buttons(StandardCommands) returns from its buttons. Finish is the dialog's ok(), on every step, which validates the whole form and shows the step of the first error.

The steps are components of the view, held by its @Exposed component fields: they share the view's Form, its result and its scope, so that going back keeps what was entered. Each step's step-title resource titles it, in the heading "Step 1 of 3: Contact Information". Its methods are called on the EDT.

  • Method Details

    • steps

      public JComponent steps(JComponent... steps)
      Returns a new panel that shows the steps: a heading, and the steps on the cards of a CardLayout, in the given order, the first shown. It is called once, during the build of the dialog view that injects this wizard.
      Parameters:
      steps - the steps, each held by an @Exposed component field of the view, nested ones included
      Returns:
      the panel, which the view returns from its content() or places in it
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if called again, outside the build of a dialog view, before its content is built, such as in its constructor, or outside the build of the view whose scope holds this wizard
      IllegalArgumentException - for no step, a step given twice, or a step that no @Exposed component field of the view holds
      NullPointerException - if the array or a step is null

    • step

    • next

      public BoundCommand next()
      Returns the command that validates the shown step and shows the next one when it is valid, enabled while the shown step isn't the last. Like ok(), it stays enabled while the step is invalid, so that activating it shows what is wrong.
      Returns:
      the command

    • buttons

      public List<BoundCommand> buttons(StandardCommands commands)
